title: Package-ready flows for 1.5 - author every built-in Flow in a shape a third-party manifest can express
description:
CLOSED 2026-08-21 - ACCEPTANCE MET, verified in the code. The card's acceptance is 'the FlowDef is fully expressible as a third-party manifest - no JS component, requiredModels/requiredDeps are catalogue ids only'. js/data/flowsRegistry.js now contains ZERO occurrences of uiComponent across all six Flows (head-swap, ltx-extend, ltx-foley, ltx-upscale, character-sheet, outpaint) and MpiFlowHeadSwap no longer exists on disk - it went with 64279953 'feat(MPI-572): flows declare their controls - uiComponent is gone'. requiredModels are catalogue ids throughout. The port surface the card fought to keep at ONE component is now ZERO.

ITEM STATUS: item 1 (FlowStepField slider/number/text + FlowDef.controls) landed 2026-08-14 and MPI-572 folded `controls` into `fields`; item 3 (author 1.5's Flows declaratively) landed across all six; item 4 (port MpiFlowHeadSwap) landed under MPI-572.

ITEM 2 IS THE ONLY PIECE NOT BUILT and it is NOT part of acceptance: steps[].image, a per-step intro image alongside title/hint/tickerLabel, rendered by MpiBaseFlow. There is no `image:` key in flowsRegistry.js. It carries to MPI-560 (the Flow track) so it is not lost - a manifest field, cheap whenever a Flow wants one, and a third party can express it.

The silent failure mode this card owed evidence on - a step field that quietly uses the graph's baked default - was proven closed by /history readback on 2026-08-17: see validation.md.

UMBRELLA: MPI-560 - The Flow track (merge of MPI-529 + MPI-552 + MPI-560, 2026-08-16). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-560/plan.md.

1.5 RELEASE BLOCKER for the Community Flows track. 1.5 ships built-in MPI Flows, NOT packages - the third-party format is deliberately deferred to 1.6. The one thing 1.5 must get right is authoring shape: every Flow written with a new JS uiComponent is a Flow that has to be ported later.

uiComponent names a JS component, so a third party can never have one. After MPI-332 rips image-regen / sdxl-4k / video-stitch (and MpiFlowImageRegen with them), the only surviving component is MpiFlowHeadSwap - so the port surface is ONE component, not three. Keep it that way.

WORK:
1. Extend FlowStepField (MpiBaseFlow/stepKinds.js + the FlowDef typedef in js/data/flowsRegistry.js) with slider / number / text. Today fields is one row of select | button | toggle, which cannot express ImageRegen-class controls. This work is needed for 1.5's Flows regardless of the format.
2. Add steps[].image - a per-step intro image alongside the existing title / hint / tickerLabel, rendered by MpiBaseFlow. Only new FlowDef field in the whole design.
3. Author 1.5's Flows declaratively via steps + fields. No new uiComponent.
4. Port MpiFlowHeadSwap to declarative steps when its controls are expressible; retiring uiComponent itself belongs to the 1.6 card.

ACCEPTANCE (checkable per Flow): the FlowDef is fully expressible as a third-party manifest - no JS component, requiredModels/requiredDeps are catalogue ids only, and every media node carries an Input_* / Output_* title.

RELATED: MPI-529 (Flow Library v2 umbrella), MPI-332 (rips the three test flows), MPI-306 (built the steps carousel + FlowStepField), MPI-299 (Head Swap). Sibling: the 1.6 community-package card.
